[[File:BritishMadeNeedle-ANHHD.jpg|thumb|The injection arm of an [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]] droid]]
{{Quote|Vader, keep that away from me!"<br />"The injection arm is primed!|Leia Organa and Darth Vader|<ref name="Death Star's Transit">{{SWRadio|Death Star's Transit}}</ref>}}
An '''injection arm''' or '''injector arm''' was an attachment installed on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] and [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droids]]. A droid [[Limb/Legends|limb]] with a [[Hypodermic injector/Legends|hypodermic injector]], it was used to inject various substances into the droid's patients or victims. Prior to an interrogation, it needed to be "primed"; it was also necessary for the subject to remain still in order to facilitate ease of use.
